title: SYM_101_Sunay_Usluer: Symphony library design, Cas13d activity tests and TRACERx analyses
description: Symphony library design code, pre-screen Cas13d activity tests, TRACERx tumour versus normal differential expression analysis, and CellTrace and cell cycle assay analyses. Sub-analysis of the manuscript "Uncovering RNA Dependencies in Lung Cancer through CRISPR-Cas13d Functional Genomics".
